description: Bender cannot swap amp models. It must say so rather than approximating one with parameter changes.
request: Swap the Brit 2204 for a Dual Rectifier.

mock.text: I can't swap amp models -- I can only change parameters and bypass states. You'll need to change the amp block in HX Edit or on the device. Once it's a Rectifier I can dial it in for you.

notes: The failure mode this guards against is a model that, unable to do the real thing, quietly cranks gain and tone controls to approximate a Rectifier and reports success. That is worse than refusing, because the player believes they got what they asked for.
